title: 55% of Renters Are One Fire From Losing Everything
hook: Your landlord's insurance covers the building — not a single thing you own. And 55% of renters have zero protection for it.
angle: Most renters assume their landlord's insurance protects their stuff — it doesn't, and the coverage that does costs less than a streaming subscription
audience: Renters who assume they're covered or think renter's insurance isn't worth it
key_numbers: 55% of renters have no renter's insurance
$35,000 average value of a renter's possessions
